ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Provider Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the efforts of the Minnesota DHS to prevent Medicaid provider fraud and the impact of these efforts on the state's Medicaid program.
ideas.angle: Data analysis of Medicaid provider fraud in Minnesota
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid provider fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the Minnesota DHS's efforts to prevent Medicaid provider fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in the Medicaid program. By analyzing data on Medicaid provider fraud, we can identify patterns and trends that can inform the Minnesota DHS's efforts to prevent fraud.
